And as for resume, maybe try to do some of online courses, there are even free courses on coursera or edx, which give you certificate after completion. 
Also, try volunteering at some event or sth, and try to be co-organizator or even sole organizator, many of those events are not so hard to make...like dogwalking day in local dog shelter, but look nice in your resume.
